choices.title_text: Ontario Towns: Population Density Growth Trends
choices.subtitle_text: Top 15 Fastest-Growing Towns (1996-2021) with Density Changes Across Census Years
Population Density and Growth Trends Across Census Years (1996–2021)
source_note_texts: **Definition:** Density = population per km². Percentage changes computed as (year_end - year_start) / year_start. Towns ranked by overall growth (1996–2021).
**Source:** Canadian Census data (1996–2021)

choices.subtitle_text: Density changes and growth rates across census years, 1996–2021
source_note_texts: **Density** measured in persons per square kilometer; **growth rate** represents percentage population change between consecutive census periods.
Data source: Statistics Canada, Census of Population (1996–2021)

choices.subtitle_text: Population Density Evolution Across Census Years (1996–2021)
